earnings.title: STERIS Announces Financial Results for Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter
highlights: Fiscal 2027 second quarter revenue increased 9%; constant currency organic revenue growth was 8%
Fiscal 2027 second quarter as reported diluted EPS increased to $2.19; adjusted EPS per diluted share increased to $2.94
Total revenue for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 increased 9% to $1.6 billion compared with $1.5 billion in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.

As reported, net income for the second quarter was $213.7 million, or $2.19 per diluted share, compared with net income of $191.9 million, or $1.94 per diluted share, in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.

Adjusted net income for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 was $286.8 million, or $2.94 per diluted share, compared with the previous year’s second quarter of $244.5 million or $2.47 per diluted share.

quotes.text: We are pleased with our second quarter performance.
quotes.by: Dan Carestio, President and CEO of STERIS

outlook: The Company anticipates total charges of approximately $45 million associated with the plan, including approximately $10 million in cash expenditures and $35 million in non-cash charges.
The plan is expected to generate annualized savings of approximately $9 million, with a portion realized in fiscal 2028 and the full benefit realized in subsequent fiscal years.
The revised outlook includes the benefit of approximately $0.18 from tariff refunds received year-to-date.

items.heading: Changes in economic climate may adversely affect us.

The effects of geopolitical instability may adversely affect us and create significant risks and uncertainties for our business, with the ultimate impact dependent on future developments, which are highly uncertain and unpredictable.

Compliance with multiple, and potentially conflicting, international laws and regulations, import and export limitations, anti-corruption laws, and exchange controls may be difficult, burdensome or expensive.

Changes in healthcare policy or government and other third-party payor reimbursement levels to healthcare providers, or failure to meet healthcare reimbursement or other requirements, might negatively impact our business.

We are subject to extensive regulatory requirements and must receive and maintain regulatory clearance or approval for many products and operations. Failure to receive or maintain, or delays in receiving, clearance or approvals may negatively impact our revenues, profitability, financial condition, or value.
